newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Centrotrade rubber opens for business in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Centrotrade rubber opens for business in U.S.

text.p: Austria's Centrobank has opened a new rubber trading subsidiary in the U.S., Centrotrade Rubber USA, to complement its existing rubber trading operations in Vienna and Singapore, the company said on Wednesday.

The new firm, based in Akron, Ohio, will trade in natural and synthetic rubber and starts its business with the core staff of a recent liquidated rubber dealership, Centrotrade Singapore said in a statement.

Centrobank is licensed both as a merchant bank and a trading house and has a trading turnover of more than US$1.0 billion in products ranging from rubber to latex, cocoa, coffee, ores, concentrates, minerals, metals and selected chemicals.
Centrotrade Rubber USA will be the company's second U.S. subsidiary after the metals/minerals operation in New York.
